domains.name: Debian 12
domains.xml:
<domain type='kvm' id='1'>
  <name>Debian 12</name>
  <uuid>803bd917-84b0-490f-ba3c-5e21b4cd6f07</uuid>
  <description>Debian 12 lab server</description>
  <metadata>
    <vmtemplate xmlns="unraid" name="Debian" iconold="debian.png" icon="debian.png" os="debian" webui="" storage="default"/>
  </metadata>
  <memory unit='KiB'>2097152</memory>
  <currentMemory unit='KiB'>2097152</currentMemory>
  <memoryBacking>
    <nosharepages/>
  </memoryBacking>
  <vcpu placement='static'>2</vcpu>
  <os>
    <type arch='x86_64' machine='pc-q35-9.2'>hvm</type>
  </os>
  <clock offset='utc'/>
  <devices>
    <emulator>/usr/local/sbin/qemu</emulator>
    <disk type='file' device='disk'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='raw' cache='writeback'/>
      <source file='/mnt/user/domains/Debian 12/vdisk1.img'/>
      <target dev='hdc' bus='virtio'/>
      <boot order='1'/>
    </disk>
    <interface type='bridge'>
      <mac address='52:54:00:00:00:02'/>
      <source bridge='br0'/>
      <model type='virtio-net'/>
    </interface>
    <graphics type='vnc' port='5900' autoport='yes' websocket='5700' listen='0.0.0.0' keymap='en-us'><listen type='address' address='0.0.0.0'/></graphics>
  </devices>
</domain>
